newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: AMS down 5.5 pct as investors bail out.
newsitem.headline: AMS down 5.5 pct as investors bail out.

text.p: Shares of Austrian chip maker AMS slumped 5.5 percent in early trading on Wednesday as investors took profits out of a recent rebound in the battered stock ahead of nine-month earnings due next week, traders said.
At 0835 GMT, Austria Mikro Systeme shares were down 43 schillings at 775.0, while the 21-share ATX index was down 5.90 points or 0.5 percent at 1,082.70.

"AMS is pretty much out of favour," said a trader. The stock has plunged more than 55 percent since last December to hit a year-low of 640 schillings in August, before rebounding to almost 900 schillings earlier this month.

Traders said investors were bailing out of the stock in expectation of bad news when the company releases quarterly earnings next Wednesday. "They're positioning themselves," said one, adding more losses were on the cards.
"The share is moving in line with U.S. technology stocks which have been rather weak over the past few days," added another. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
